experiment: stepped sweep counts (the runners and the integration, phase 2): VACASK sweeps from=0 to=0.3 step=0.1, 0 to 0.7, 0 to 1 step 0.25, a descending dec sweep and a descending dec ac; Xyce .DC 0 0.3 0.1 and 0 0.7 0.1, .DC DEC from 1 down to 1m, .AC DEC 10 1 1MEG, .AC LIN 4 1K 4K, and .AC DEC and LIN with start > stop
result: VACASK runs n = ceil((to - from)/step) points, plus one when from + n*step <= to (lib/answeep.cpp): 0 to 0.3 by 0.1 runs 3 points and 0 to 0.7 runs 7 (0.3/0.1 is 2.9999999999999996, 3*0.1 is 0.30000000000000004), where the plan's grid has 4 and 8; 0 to 1 by 0.25 runs 5; Xyce's .DC and .AC counts equal the plan's grid (4, 8, 61, 4). Added in phase 2c (R-emit-19): VACASK runs a descending dec sweep natively (dc 1 V down to 1 mV and ac 1 MHz down to 1 kHz, 4 points each); Xyce's .DC DEC with start > stop computes one step, with a warning; .AC DEC and .AC LIN with start > stop are a netlist error, rc 1
rules: §4.5 / §7.1: render prints a stepped grid whose float steps miss the end as values=[...] on VACASK (vacask.step_values), and the VACASK runner counts the points VACASK runs (run_vacask.vacask_count)
§7.2: Xyce's .DC and .AC grids are the plan's (results.grid_values), the failed-point detection counting them

R-emit-3 / R-emit-4 (phase 2c): a descending dec grid runs as it is on VACASK; on Xyce a .DC or .STEP DEC with start > stop computes one point and an .AC grid with start > stop is refused, so render must not print either
